sources.title: Migrate from prompt objects | OpenAI API

behaviorChanges: Execute migrated workflows through the Responses API and keep model selection, instructions, and tool declarations in application-owned configuration instead of reusable Prompt objects.
Use the Conversations API only when the application requires durable server-side conversation state; Responses can also run without a Conversation.
Backfill Thread messages to Conversation Items deliberately because OpenAI does not provide an automated Thread-to-Conversation migration tool.
Replace Run and Run Step orchestration with Responses and Items; application code owns history pruning, tool loops, and retries.
Review streaming, tool-calling, file-search, and code-interpreter semantics before changing code.
